name: Primer Inspired
description: An independent interpretation of Primer's public design principles: 6px corners on controls and boxes, 12px on overlays, pill labels, boxes drawn by a border alone, controls outlined in the strong border color and boxes and rows ruled in the default one, a 2px ring 2px off the edge, a floating shadow with its own hairline under overlays, solid glyph icons, 32px controls with 12px padding, and quick ease-out motion that never nudges. It ships no official component, token file, icon, or font.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, after Primer's public principles. Not affiliated with or endorsed by GitHub.
provenance.derivation: The reviewed prototype's primer recipe, with its --appearance-* references read as --color-*, and the contract's signature-fill and emphasis-glow at the fallback language's values.

fallbacks: Under reduced transparency, without backdrop-filter, in forced colors, and in print, surfaces render opaque and the backdrop blur is 0.
Under reduced motion, transforms and emphasis stop and entrances and exits fade; a paused boundary and print are instant.

tokens.shadow-overlay: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-border-default), 0 6px 12px -3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 4%, transparent), 0 6px 18px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 12%, transparent)
tokens.shadow-raised: 0 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 10%, transparent), 0 3px 6px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 12%, transparent)
